messages:
alex: RFC follow-up: propose a RETIRE state for pinned pages to avoid hard-tearing during rebalances. idea: mark page RETIRE+epoch, block new pins, let existing pins drain or timeout.

maya: how is that different from soft-demote?

alex: soft-demote just reduces prefetch/evict priority. RETIRE forbids new pins and returns E_RETIRED to callers; existing pins get an epoch token to finish. migrator moves when epoch quiescent or TTL expires.

ron: TTL? forced migration behavior?

sorin: default TTL=30s, then forced copy-on-write migrate and bump page.version to make stale pins retry. record forced_migrate metric.

maya: provide pin_with_backoff helper to handle E_RETIRED/E_STALE so callers don't explode.

liz: kvcache interaction? we need version checks so kvcache entries detect moved backing and retry.

alex: plan: compact header with version+epoch in one word; pins record version. on mismatch callers retry. add is_retired fast-check for prefetch.

ron: testing: unit tests for header bump, chaos test with long-sleep pin > TTL to exercise forced migrate, perf microbench for header checks.

maya: rollout: opt-in runtime flag, land helper + canary service, monitor retire_duration and forced_migrate_rate.

deploy-bot: canary build retire-mode=opt-in scheduled 2026-03-25T09:00Z for 48h.

alex: i'll write RFC update with sequence diagram, small API snippet, and metrics. will post branch link.
